notes.title: Next Fest is almost over - how was it?
notes.notes:
Hi beautiful people!

The Steam Next Fest is coming to an end. We're proud that we could take our part in it.

Hope you guys enjoyed the demo. It's a small chunk of our early game. We're still working on the final product, but the demo mostly conveys how it will look. We're gathering your feedback and trying to work on the most irritating issues and stuff you're informing us about.

So yeah, please feel free to share your feedback with us, tell us what you liked, what went wrong for you, etc. You can also share some nice demos you've played on the Fest, we'd love to check them out too.

Have a great Summer folks!
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/364110977379336192/1122849436444401765/Zarumieniony2_kopia.png[/img]

notes.title: Magin on the Steam Summer Next Fest 2023
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
So, we're attending the Steam Next Fest June 19 - 26! We're very happy to present you guys with the new demo ^^ It's still a work in progress so you can expect some updates from us on the demo itself and on the final product of course. [previewyoutube=DrmOeXEO0WU;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!

notes.title: 2023 Magin: TRPS Developement Plans!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As some of you might know, 2023 is the year we'll finally be launching our much-anticipated game! While we're not ready to share a specific release date just yet, rest assured it won't be in the next week. We want to give you ample time to prepare for the big day, so don't worry :D (Some say it's somewhere around Q3 - Q4)

Currently, our team is hard at work integrating a significant portion of the game's content into the latest build. As it stands, we have quite a fewl hours' worth of story gameplay implemented for internal testing purposes. In terms of production, we're focused on creating assets for the latter half of the game and its ending. Alongside this, we're refining some of our older assets and adding extra flair, some of that sweet juice, such as additional environmental animations, animals etc.

As the release date draws closer, we'll also be dedicating some effort towards creating marketing materials. Our goal is to have some captivating gameplay and story trailers ready to showcase later this year, but we'll keep you updated on how that pans out :D

We hope all of you are staying well, and we appreciate your continued support!

If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to leave a comment! We'll do our best to respond as quickly as possible.

Take care, everyone! ^^


Our Innkeeper also extends a warm and cheerful "G'day" to all of you!

notes.title: We're attending the LudoNarraCon!
notes.notes:
Hello folks! 
So yeah, as you might have noticed by the title of this news, 
We're attending the [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/exhibitors]LNC[/url] - an event hosted[b] on Steam[/b] that celebrates narrative, story-rich games so I guess we fit well :D

The LudoNarraCon will have over 40 game exhibitors exhibiting behind-the-scenes content on their steam page, 12+ panels from industry leaders live on our main ‘theatre’ steam, a sale featuring over 140 story-rich games, plus 30+ playable demos during the event!

We'll be there with our last demo, it's not that fresh in terms of our current state of the game and we'll be coming up with the newer and better ones later on, but it's still awesome and we hope you'll like it! For some of You, it'll be a chance to give it a second playthrough :D

[b]See you at the event! 5th - 9th May 2022 Cheers! :D[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36385734/6a4441bdd0c93ea78eb7f5809dedff60b86b0eab.png[/img]

notes.title: Game status update and Publisher reveal!
notes.notes:
So folks! We haven't spoken in a while! 
We've been busy, but finally, we're ready to shed some light on the status of our game.
It's still early in the development stage, but we want to share some big news with You!

[b]We're getting published by the one and only - Daedalic Entertainment![/b]

That's right! We're developing Magin: The Rat Project Stories together with the great people of Daedalic!
They love our ideas for the game and we're thrilled to be producing it with them. It's a pleasure to stand alongside Daedalic's games such as Deponia, Ken Follet's The Pillars of the Earth, Shadow Tactics, etc.

We'll keep you updated on the game's future and our plans. Hope You are all doing well! 

The game will progressively get more and more highlights worldwide. We're not yet holding any big announcements with new promo assets and trailers. The game is being developed as we speak and we want to hit the market with some strong assets later - when we really have some shiny, juicy bits to show. For now, we stay lowkey, but You can expect some news about us attending events or making other moves :D [b]WE'RE ALIVE AND DOING WELL![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36385734/377eb909f5ea94c1c964c334f4f32105ff49a635.png[/img]


[i]PS. We were devastated to hear the news regarding Ukraine and the start of the war. Hope none of You and your relatives and friends were victims of the aggression. No one should have to experience the horrors of war. We're hoping for the best possible solution to this situation and a peaceful future. We're sending our love to the people of Ukraine. [/i]

notes.title: November Magin: TRPS news
notes.notes:
Hi there ladies and gents!

Hope You're all safe and sound! 

It's been a month since the last update and there's a lot of work we've done with the project to push it forward. We're being meticulous with the funds we've got since they're quite limited, but we're expanding our team with some new, talented folks that will hopefully help us get the best results with the game :D We'll have them introduced to You soon. 

We're constantly working on the game's full scenario script and gameplay flow. We're tweaking the game's core mechanics and prototyping them to make sure that the deck building and card combat aspects give as much satisfaction as they can. Mainly we're testing a few iterations of the Emotion Axis's functionalities and how they can affect the cards, tactics, strategies, and combat flow.

 We're also designing and producing the locations needed for the full game. Since the beginning, we were assuming that we'll need about 15-20 locations (smaller and bigger ones) to fully cover the story, make it immersive, get the world-building done right. Not to spoil too much, let us show you some of the progress ;)

[h1]We are live on Kickstarter[/h1]
[h3]With your help we'll be able to continue the development[/h3]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/471857358/magin-narrative-driven-deck-building-adventure-rpg?ref=user_menu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36385734/822198600a112ad72923c513afb39c9130418fe0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]If you haven't played yet[/h1]

[h2]The demo offers [b]3[/b] game modes:[/h2]

[b] Full experience[/b] - The game as it was created. It contains both story, exploration and card based combat.
 
 [b]Story mode [/b]- if you don’t fancy card games, you can still enjoy the story, visuals and music. This mode will auto resolve the encounter.
 
 [b]Combat mode[/b] - for those who want to explore the combat system more thoroughly.  In this mode, you can choose your deck variant and  go  straight into the fight.


[h1]Check the teaser[/h1]
[previewyoutube=bx1Ksogko54;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Story[/h1]
[b]Magin is the story of two characters - Tolen and Elester - Magins, mediums of the Essence.[/b] Though holding few things in common, they are bound by a fate that neither of them suspects. We want to tell a story that stays with you, one where important choices are yours to be made.

[h1]Setting[/h1]
A dark fantasy world, where magic is directly tied to the desires and fears of its inhabitants. A world that stands on the verge of an industrial revolution, where races and cultures mix and cease to determine one’s path in life. A place where classical fantasy motifs are met with the relativity of modern morality.

[h1]Card based combat/h1]

[list]
[*]You gain cards by exploring the world and by making narrative choices. Your collection is a reflection of the path your character has walked, and the experiences they’ve gathered. From those, you are free to build a deck that you take with you into combat.
[*]The game will offer 3 main deck types, that you can mix and match, leading to a wide variety of playstyles.
[*]Your deck can be further customized by unlocking powerful, magical abilities that change the way you play
[*]Your combat skills will be tested by a variety of challenges that bar your way as you progress through the story or explore one of the game’s immersive, lore-rich dungeons.
[/list]

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
In Magin, we want the music to enhance the narrative, immerse you in the world, and tug at your heartstrings. Our composer - Tom Acrofear - is a genius at creating melodies that speak directly to the soul. Tom has been in our team from the very beginning, and his music plays a pivotal role in representing the emotions that are a major part of the main characters’ powers.
[previewyoutube=eSHUfc69pMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Our team[/h1]
We're a fully independent team of hard-working developers, trying to bring to life a vision 3 years in the making. Independence is very important to us - we have a strong vision for the game that we do not want to compromise. This is why we’re convinced that the best way to keep that spirit alive and deliver a quality product is to ask other gamers for help directly. So far we’ve been working without any funding, but recently we launched a Kickstarter campaign. Hopefully it will allow us to keep fulfilling our dream of making a great game
